Players Committee card image of [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. Your artillery weapons on Hoth are powered.

'''Dark Side:''' Your movement to or from here requires +1 Force. If 'blown away,' Light Side loses 8 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/hothmainpowergenerators.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/hothmainpowergenerators.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
